info.title: Trading AWS Gateway (MCP tools parity)
info.description: OpenAPI mapping of FastMCP tools in mcp_server.py: Lambda-backed news fetch, sentiment analysis (SQS-shaped payload), and trade execution. For Amazon Bedrock Agents, attach this schema to an action group and implement the single router Lambda (lambdas/bedrock_trading_router/app.py); 200 response bodies must match LambdaInvokeEnvelope (ok, function_name, status_code, response, optional step/next).

servers.description: Replace with your API Gateway base URL or Bedrock Action Group proxy.

post.description: Invoke the news_fetcher Lambda to pull recent headlines for configured symbols (TOP_SYMBOLS in Lambda env) and enqueue a batch message for sentiment analysis (typically SQS). Optional EventBridge-shaped payload; empty body is valid. Returns status, run_id, symbols, or an error payload.

Invoke sentiment_analyzer with a synthetic SQS event whose Record body is JSON matching news_fetcher SQS messages. Requires run_id, symbols (non-empty), and articles_by_symbol. Runs Claude, writes SENTIMENT rows to DynamoDB, may invoke trade_executor. Returns Lambda handler response (e.g. status, processed) or error.
Invoke trade_executor with pipeline run_id. Must match SENTIMENT rows for that run. Loads strategy config, queries sentiment from DynamoDB, places idempotent Alpaca paper trades.

event.description: Optional EventBridge-style payload forwarded as the Lambda event dict. Omitted or empty object {} matches MCP default.

message_body.description: Exact JSON that news_fetcher puts in SQS MessageBody (and MCP passes to sentiment_analyzer).

SentimentQueueMessageBody.description: SQS message JSON string content. Core fields below are required by sentiment_analyzer; extra keys are ignored safely.

run_id.description: Correlation id for the batch (UUID recommended); must be unique per pipeline run.

triggered_at.description: When the news job was triggered (ISO-8601 UTC).

symbols.description: Uppercase tickers to analyze; must be non-empty (validated in sentiment_analyzer).

lookback_hours.description: News lookback window in hours (matches news_fetcher env NEWS_LOOKBACK_HOURS semantics).

articles_by_symbol.description: Map each symbol to a list of normalized NewsAPI-style articles (may be empty lists per symbol).

source.description: Optional provenance (news_fetcher sets lambda_request_id, fetched_at; MCP may add tags).

url.description: Article URL; may be empty if the source omitted it.

publishedAt.description: Publication time string from NewsAPI (often ISO-8601).

lambda_request_id.description: AWS request id when produced by news_fetcher.

fetched_at.description: UTC time when articles were assembled.

mcp.description: Optional tag when invoked via MCP.

run_id.description: Must match the run_id for which SENTIMENT items exist in DynamoDB.

LambdaInvokeEnvelope.description: Returned by the Bedrock router and mcp_server._invoke_lambda: outer envelope plus optional routing hints. The inner Lambda JSON is in "response" (e.g. news_fetcher: status, run_id, symbols).

status_code.description: AWS Lambda Invoke API HTTP status (200 when invoke succeeded).

response.description: Parsed target Lambda payload on success (not the boto invoke envelope).

error.description: Present when ok is false (boto/Lambda FunctionError).

step.description: Router step id: fetch_market_news | analyze_sentiment | execute_trade.

next.description: Optional hints for the following tool call (message_body, run_id, description).
